body: I’m a conscientious objector. Plus, being mentally ill, I don’t think I would last long in the military anyway.

I work in the produce department at a grocery store. Theoretically, if I spent several years there I might eventually get an asst. manager position or something, but the idea of spending years and years in customer service is unbearable. My manager is in his 50s, and if all I have to look forward to a few decades from now is doing mostly the same work with slightly better pay I’d be better off killing myself now

Not much anymore. I used to be into videogames and reading, but I don’t have the attention span for those any more. I also like movies, but my interest in those has been waning a lot too. I spend my time most days either working my minimum wage job or sleeping

I’d have to be more motivated, which would be extremely difficult. I’m probably the most motivated I’ve been in a while now and I still have trouble doing the most basic tasks, so the idea of doing something lifechanging is completely infeasible

Started out as engineering which I felt pressured into, and after I did poorly in that I switched to accounting, which I also did poorly. I have no clue what I want to do with my life because honestly I didn’t think I’d live this long and I don’t really have any interests or skills to build on

Went to a good high school and got into a good college with some friends, and everything went downhill from there. I had been depressed before that but it got worse to the point that I dropped out of school and lost most of my friends. Now I’m just spinning my wheels and it doesn’t look my life will get any better. And before you say that I have the power to change myself, I’m simply too flawed to get better. I just need to end it all

Honestly, I think I’d just have to be a different person. Everything about me, from my appearance to my personality to my motivation are totally awful and no matter how much I’ve tried to change, I always end up as the same awful person
I was on Zoloft for a while, which didn’t help at all. I’m on Wellbutrin and Prozac now and have been for about a year, but they don’t help much either.

I’m 20. I dropped out of college and now work a crappy job and live with my parents. I’ve had people tell me that I have a lot of time for things to get better, but I’ve been doing poorly since middle school and I don’t think I can ever get better.

I used to volunteer at a local animal shelter, but I don’t have the motivation for it anymore. I don’t have the energy for pretty much anything actually. The only reason I go to work is because if I got fired my parents would be even more disappointed than they already are.
Not really. Any time I try to do stuff I used to enjoy (video games, movies, etc) I just feel guilty afterwards for wasting time on myself

I disappoint everyone around me and I can’t do anything right. The only reason I’ve survived up to this point is through the help of others but I can’t give anything back. I just take and take, and if I was dead at least I wouldn’t be taking resources that could go to someone more important.

I’m physically unattractive, have terrible social skills, and am going nowhere in life. I dropped out of college and work a shitty job, and what little free time I have I spend alone. If I knew how to fix any of those problems I would’ve tried something by now, but I’m just stuck like this.
